findings.claim: A failed keyed batch can deliver webhooks and then release the key, so the identical retry delivers those webhooks again.
findings.evidence: Forced failure on the second insertion left zero local rows but two delivered webhooks; retry delivered the first pair again and completed with six deliveries total.
findings.layer: end-to-end idempotency across external side effects

findings.claim: SIGINT or SIGTERM can arrive after the generated-secret file is linked but before the startup guard is installed, leaving the file and blocking retry.
findings.evidence: Real SIGTERM in the post-link publisher window exited 143, left the file, and immediate retry failed already exists.
findings.layer: OS signal and filesystem publication boundary

findings.claim: Adapter persistence can restore an orphaned in_progress reservation after the owner process dies, trapping the key as concurrent until expiry.
findings.evidence: A concurrent POST persisted state=in_progress; after owner SIGKILL and process restart, the identical retry returned 409 concurrent_idempotent_requests.
findings.layer: persistent lifecycle ownership across process restart
findings.path: getResendStore → resendPlugin via call → adapter persistence save
